title: From Earth to Orbit, France’s Ecosystem Delivers Agentic Computing at Scale With NVIDIA
script:
France is now deploying agentic AI across its national industries using NVIDIA technology.
The country moved from ambition to application after the AI Action Summit in February 2025.
Major compute commitments were secured during the 2025 and 2026 Choose France summits.
These deployments cover sectors ranging from space and financial services to scientific research.
This ecosystem helps businesses automate complex tasks by using autonomous AI agents at scale.
The nation is now focused on moving these deliberate compute investments into real-world production.
Would you let an autonomous agent manage critical national infrastructure?
